en.setting: The Royal Conservatory occupies a stone building on a cobbled square, where the stairwell rises four floors around a central void and the overhead lamps go dark after nine. A prize-winning sonata is to be performed tonight, and the archive in the basement holds manuscripts that could rewrite its credits.
en.crime: Professor Lang was found at the base of the main stairwell at dawn. The railing on the third-floor landing had broken at two bolt points, the stairs were slick with fresh polish, and his briefcase lay open with an exam report beside him.

suspects.name: Marta Solis
suspects.intro: The prize-winning violinist who submitted the sonata under her own name, her bow hand steady and her wrist bearing a fresh rosin burn.

suspects.name: Karl Brennan
suspects.intro: Waited in the recital hall after intermission, his scarf torn and snagged on the stair rail.

suspects.name: Dr Irina Voss
suspects.intro: External examiner whose report on the submission was due the following morning.

suspects.name: Felix Morel
suspects.intro: Visited the archive six times in a month, claiming research on the Kovar sonata.

suspects.name: Anna Czerny
suspects.intro: Delivered flowers to the recital hall and left through the loading dock, not seen again until morning.

suspects.name: Director Pask
suspects.intro: Holds the master keycard and secured conservatory funding based on the prize winner's reputation.

suspects.name: Jan Kovar
suspects.intro: Taught composition for thirty years and whose manuscript notebooks are stored under restricted access.

es.setting: El Real Conservatorio ocupa un edificio de piedra en una plaza adoquinada, donde la escalera sube cuatro pisos alrededor de un vacio central y las lamparas superiores se apagan despues de las nueve. Una sonata ganadora de premio sera interpretada esta noche, y el archivo en el sotano guarda manuscritos que podrian reescribir sus creditos.
es.crime: El Profesor Lang fue encontrado al pie de la escalera principal al amanecer. La barandilla del rellano del tercer piso se habia roto en dos puntos de anclaje, los escalones estaban resbaladizos con cera fresca, y su maletin yacia abierto con un informe de examen a su lado.

suspects.name: Marta Solis
suspects.intro: La violinista ganadora del premio que presento la sonata bajo su propio nombre, su mano de arco firme y su muneca con una quemadura fresca de resina.

suspects.name: Karl Brennan
suspects.intro: Espero en la sala de recitales despues del intermedio, su bufanda rasgada y enganchada en la barandilla.

suspects.name: Dra. Irina Voss
suspects.intro: Examinadora externa cuyo informe sobre la presentacion debia entregarse a la manana siguiente.

suspects.name: Felix Morel
suspects.intro: Visito el archivo seis veces en un mes, alegando investigacion sobre la sonata de Kovar.

suspects.name: Anna Czerny
suspects.intro: Entrego flores a la sala de recitales y salio por el muelle de carga, no vista de nuevo hasta la manana.

suspects.name: Director Pask
suspects.intro: Posee la tarjeta maestra y aseguro la financiacion del conservatorio basandose en la reputacion de la ganadora del premio.

suspects.name: Jan Kovar
suspects.intro: Enseno composicion durante treinta anos y cuyos cuadernos de manuscritos se guardan bajo acceso restringido.

fr.setting: Le Conservatoire Royal occupe un batiment de pierre sur une place pavee, ou la cage d'escalier monte sur quatre etages autour d'un vide central et les lampes s'eteignent apres neuf heures. Une sonate primee doit etre jouee ce soir, et les archives au sous-sol conservent des manuscrits qui pourraient en reecrire les credits.
fr.crime: Le Professeur Lang a ete retrouve au pied de l'escalier principal a l'aube. La rampe du palier du troisieme etage s'etait brisee a deux points de fixation, les marches etaient glissantes de cire fraiche, et sa serviette etait ouverte avec un rapport d'examen a cote de lui.

suspects.name: Marta Solis
suspects.intro: La violoniste primee qui a soumis la sonate sous son propre nom, sa main d'archet ferme et son poignet portant une brulure fraiche de colophane.

suspects.name: Karl Brennan
suspects.intro: A attendu dans la salle de recital apres l'entracte, son echarpe dechiree et accrochee a la rampe d'escalier.

suspects.name: Dr Irina Voss
suspects.intro: Examinatrice externe dont le rapport sur la soumission etait attendu le lendemain matin.

suspects.name: Felix Morel
suspects.intro: A visite les archives six fois en un mois, pretextant des recherches sur la sonate de Kovar.

suspects.name: Anna Czerny
suspects.intro: A livre des fleurs a la salle de recital et est partie par le quai de chargement, non revue jusqu'au matin.

suspects.name: Directeur Pask
suspects.intro: Detient le badge maitre et a obtenu le financement du conservatoire sur la reputation de la laureat du prix.

suspects.name: Jan Kovar
suspects.intro: A enseigne la composition pendant trente ans et dont les cahiers de manuscrits sont conserves sous acces restreint.

physical_evidence.en: The railing bolts on the third-floor landing had been filed down to shear under weight. The stairs were slick with fresh polish applied after hours. Rosin from a violin bow was found smeared on the railing where it broke, and Lang's briefcase lay open with the exam report beside him at the base of the stairwell.
physical_evidence.es: Los pernos de la barandilla del rellano del tercer piso habian sido limados para romperse bajo el peso. Las escaleras estaban resbaladizas con cera fresca aplicada fuera de horario. Resina de un arco de violin fue encontrada en la barandilla donde se rompio, y el maletin de Lang yacia abierto con el informe de examen junto a el al pie de la escalera.
physical_evidence.fr: Les boulons de la rampe du palier du troisieme etage avaient ete limes pour ceder sous le poids. Les marches etaient glissantes de cire fraiche appliquee apres les heures. De la colophane d'archet de violon a ete trouvee sur la rampe a l'endroit de la rupture, et la serviette de Lang etait ouverte avec le rapport d'examen a cote de lui au pied de l'escalier.

witness_testimony.en: Karl Brennan waited in the recital hall after intermission, his scarf torn and snagged on the stair rail. Anna Czerny left through the loading dock and was not seen again until morning. Felix Morel visited the archive six times in a month, and each time the Kovar manuscripts were moved from their shelf.
witness_testimony.es: Karl Brennan espero en la sala de recitales despues del intermedio, su bufanda rasgada y enganchada en la barandilla. Anna Czerny salio por el muelle de carga y no fue vista de nuevo hasta la manana. Felix Morel visito el archivo seis veces en un mes, y cada vez los manuscritos de Kovar habian sido movidos de su estante.
witness_testimony.fr: Karl Brennan a attendu dans la salle de recital apres l'entracte, son echarpe dechiree et accrochee a la rampe d'escalier. Anna Czerny est partie par le quai de chargement et n'a pas ete revue jusqu'au matin. Felix Morel a visite les archives six fois en un mois, et chaque fois les manuscrits de Kovar avaient ete deplaces de leur etagere.

financial_trail.en: The prize sonata was Jan Kovar's work. The manuscript in the archive proved it, and the ink analysis confirmed the original predated Solis's submission by thirty years. Lang's exam report laid the plagiarism bare, and Director Pask's conservatory funding depended on the prize winner's reputation.
financial_trail.es: La sonata premiada era obra de Jan Kovar. El manuscrito en el archivo lo probaba, y el analisis de tinta confirmo que el original era treinta anos anterior a la presentacion de Solis. El informe de Lang dejaba el plagio al descubierto, y la financiacion del conservatorio del Director Pask dependia de la reputacion de la ganadora del premio.
financial_trail.fr: La sonate primee etait l'oeuvre de Jan Kovar. Le manuscrit aux archives le prouvait, et l'analyse d'encre a confirme que l'original predatait la soumission de Solis de trente ans. Le rapport d'examen de Lang mettait le plagiat a nu, et le financement du conservatoire du Directeur Pask dependait de la reputation de la laureat.

emotional_tells.en: Solis's wrist bore a fresh rosin burn, and her bow hand was steady when she denied everything. Dr Irina Voss refused to submit her external report after the death. Director Pask locked the archive with the master keycard and said the matter was closed.
emotional_tells.es: La muneca de Solis tenia una quemadura fresca de resina, y su mano de arco era firme cuando lo nego todo. La Dra. Irina Voss se nego a presentar su informe externo despues de la muerte. El Director Pask cerro el archivo con la tarjeta maestra y dijo que el asunto estaba cerrado.
emotional_tells.fr: Le poignet de Solis portait une brulure fraiche de colophane, et sa main d'archet etait ferme quand elle a tout nie. Le Dr Irina Voss a refuse de soumettre son rapport externe apres le deces. Le Directeur Pask a verrouille les archives avec le badge maitre et declare l'affaire close.

cold_case_physical.en: The stairwell was repaired and the railing re-bolted within the week. The polish was cleaned, the rosin wiped away, and the cleaning woman who found the body remembered the slippery stairs but no one asked her twice. The exam report was never submitted.
cold_case_physical.es: La escalera fue reparada y la barandilla reatornillada en una semana. La cera fue limpiada, la resina eliminada, y la mujer de la limpieza que encontro el cuerpo recordaba las escaleras resbaladizas pero nadie le pregunto dos veces. El informe de examen nunca fue presentado.
cold_case_physical.fr: L'escalier a ete repare et la rampe reboulonnee dans la semaine. La cire a ete nettoyee, la colophane essuyee, et la femme de menage qui a trouve le corps se souvenait des marches glissantes mais personne ne l'a interrogee deux fois. Le rapport d'examen n'a jamais ete soumis.

cold_case_financial.en: The manuscript comparison was never completed, and the prize committee saw no reason to revisit a decision already celebrated. The recording contract stood, the conservatory funding continued, and the Kovar notebooks remained under restricted access in the basement archive, gathering dust beside a truth that no one wanted to hear.
cold_case_financial.es: La comparacion de manuscritos nunca fue completada, y el comite del premio no vio razon para reconsiderar una decision ya celebrada. El contrato de grabacion se mantuvo, la financiacion del conservatorio continuo, y los cuadernos de Kovar permanecieron bajo acceso restringido en el archivo del sotano, acumulando polvo junto a una verdad que nadie queria escuchar.
cold_case_financial.fr: La comparaison des manuscrits n'a jamais ete achevee, et le comite du prix n'a vu aucune raison de revenir sur une decision deja celebree. Le contrat d'enregistrement a tenu, le financement du conservatoire a continue, et les cahiers de Kovar sont restes sous acces restreint dans les archives du sous-sol, prenant la poussiere a cote d'une verite que personne ne voulait entendre.

all_strong.en: Marta Solis had filed the railing bolts, polished the stairs, and waited for Professor Lang to confront her on the darkened landing. The prize sonata was Jan Kovar's work — the manuscript proved it, the ink analysis confirmed it, and Lang's exam report laid the plagiarism bare. She killed him to keep the prize, the recording contract, and the career she had built on a stolen composition. The rosin on the railing, the loosened bolts, the polished steps: every note of evidence played in tune.
all_strong.es: Marta Solis habia limado los pernos de la barandilla, encerado las escaleras, y esperado a que el Profesor Lang la confrontara en el rellano oscurecido. La sonata premiada era obra de Jan Kovar — el manuscrito lo probaba, el analisis de tinta lo confirmaba, y el informe del Profesor Lang dejaba el plagio al descubierto. Lo mato para conservar el premio, el contrato de grabacion y la carrera que habia construido sobre una composicion robada. La resina en la barandilla, los pernos aflojados, los escalones encerados: cada nota de evidencia sonaba afinada.
all_strong.fr: Marta Solis avait lime les boulons de la rampe, cire les marches et attendu que le Professeur Lang la confronte sur le palier assombri. La sonate primee etait l'oeuvre de Jan Kovar — le manuscrit le prouvait, l'analyse d'encre le confirmait, et le rapport d'examen de Lang mettait le plagiat a nu. Elle l'a tue pour garder le prix, le contrat d'enregistrement et la carriere qu'elle avait batie sur une composition volee. La colophane sur la rampe, les boulons desserres, les marches cirees : chaque note de preuve jouait juste.

who_strong_rest_weak.en: Solis was the name on everyone's lips after the recital, but for the wrong reasons. The plagiarism was suspected, the confrontation overheard, and her rosin on the rail placed her at the scene. Yet the filed bolts could have been anyone's work, the polish anyone's hand, and the darkened corridor hid more than it revealed. She was charged on the strength of motive alone, and the conservatory's reputation cracked along with the case.
who_strong_rest_weak.es: Solis era el nombre en los labios de todos despues del recital, pero por las razones equivocadas. Se sospechaba el plagio, la confrontacion fue escuchada, y su resina en la barandilla la situaba en la escena. Sin embargo, los pernos limados podian haber sido obra de cualquiera, la cera de cualquier mano, y el corredor oscurecido ocultaba mas de lo que revelaba. Fue acusada por la fuerza del motivo solamente, y la reputacion del conservatorio se agrieto junto con el caso.
who_strong_rest_weak.fr: Solis etait le nom sur toutes les levres apres le recital, mais pour les mauvaises raisons. Le plagiat etait soupconne, la confrontation entendue, et sa colophane sur la rampe la placait sur les lieux. Pourtant, les boulons limes auraient pu etre l'oeuvre de n'importe qui, la cire de n'importe quelle main, et le couloir assombri cachait plus qu'il ne revelait. Elle fut inculpee sur la seule force du mobile, et la reputation du conservatoire s'est fissuree en meme temps que l'affaire.

wrong_accusation.en: The wrong musician was named, and Marta Solis took her bow to a standing ovation the following season. The Kovar manuscript remained in the archive, the exam report was filed without action, and Professor Lang's death was recorded as an accidental fall on polished stairs. The prize sonata continued to be performed under her name, and the truth lay buried in a basement archive that no one had reason to visit again.
wrong_accusation.es: Se nombro al musico equivocado, y Marta Solis hizo su reverencia ante una ovacion de pie la temporada siguiente. El manuscrito de Kovar permanecio en el archivo, el informe de examen fue archivado sin accion, y la muerte del Profesor Lang fue registrada como una caida accidental en escaleras enceradas. La sonata premiada continuo interpretandose bajo su nombre, y la verdad quedo enterrada en un archivo de sotano que nadie tenia razon para visitar de nuevo.
wrong_accusation.fr: Le mauvais musicien a ete designe, et Marta Solis a salue sous les ovations debout la saison suivante. Le manuscrit de Kovar est reste aux archives, le rapport d'examen a ete classe sans suite, et la mort du Professeur Lang a ete enregistree comme une chute accidentelle dans un escalier cire. La sonate primee a continue d'etre jouee sous son nom, et la verite est restee ensevelie dans des archives de sous-sol que personne n'avait de raison de revisiter.

cold_case.en: The stairwell was repaired, the railing re-bolted, and the conservatory resumed its season without Professor Lang. The exam report was never submitted, the manuscript comparison never completed, and the prize committee saw no reason to revisit a decision already celebrated. The cleaning woman who found the body remembered the slippery stairs and the broken rail, but no one asked her twice. The resonance of the truth faded into the stone walls and was heard by no one.
cold_case.es: La escalera fue reparada, la barandilla reatornillada, y el conservatorio reanudo su temporada sin el Profesor Lang. El informe de examen nunca fue presentado, la comparacion de manuscritos nunca completada, y el comite del premio no vio razon para reconsiderar una decision ya celebrada. La mujer de la limpieza que encontro el cuerpo recordaba las escaleras resbaladizas y la barandilla rota, pero nadie le pregunto dos veces. La resonancia de la verdad se desvanecio en los muros de piedra y no fue escuchada por nadie.
cold_case.fr: L'escalier a ete repare, la rampe reboulonnee, et le conservatoire a repris sa saison sans le Professeur Lang. Le rapport d'examen n'a jamais ete soumis, la comparaison des manuscrits jamais achevee, et le comite du prix n'a vu aucune raison de revenir sur une decision deja celebree. La femme de menage qui a trouve le corps se souvenait des marches glissantes et de la rampe cassee, mais personne ne l'a interrogee deux fois. La resonance de la verite s'est perdue dans les murs de pierre et n'a ete entendue par personne.

lucky_guess.en: Solis was named because she had the most to lose and the rosin on her fingers matched the smear on the rail. It was circumstance more than proof, instinct more than investigation. The filed bolts were never traced to her hand, the polish never sourced, and the darkened corridor offered no witnesses. She was convicted on the shape of the story rather than its substance, and the conservatory closed the case the way it tunes a piano — by adjusting until it sounds right.
lucky_guess.es: Solis fue nombrada porque era quien mas tenia que perder y la resina en sus dedos coincidia con la marca en la barandilla. Era mas circunstancia que prueba, mas instinto que investigacion. Los pernos limados nunca fueron rastreados hasta su mano, la cera nunca fue identificada, y el corredor oscurecido no ofrecio testigos. Fue condenada por la forma de la historia mas que por su sustancia, y el conservatorio cerro el caso como afina un piano — ajustando hasta que suena bien.
lucky_guess.fr: Solis a ete designee parce qu'elle avait le plus a perdre et que la colophane sur ses doigts correspondait a la trace sur la rampe. C'etait de la circonstance plus que de la preuve, de l'instinct plus que de l'investigation. Les boulons limes n'ont jamais ete retracees a sa main, la cire jamais identifiee, et le couloir assombri n'offrait aucun temoin. Elle a ete condamnee sur la forme de l'histoire plutot que sur sa substance, et le conservatoire a clos l'affaire comme on accorde un piano — en ajustant jusqu'a ce que ca sonne juste.

expressions.suspect:marta_solis: Marta Solis sat with her violin case on her lap during questioning. Her bow hand was steady but her left wrist bore a fresh rosin burn.
expressions.event:stairwell_fall: Professor Lang fell from the third-floor landing to the stone lobby below. The railing gave way and the stairs were slick with polish.
expressions.motive:stolen_composition: The prize-winning sonata submitted under Solis's name was composed by Jan Kovar in 1987. Lang had found the original manuscript in the archive.
expressions.suspect:karl_brennan: Karl Brennan waited in the recital hall after the interval was called. His scarf was caught on the stair rail and torn at one end.
expressions.suspect:dr_irina_voss: Dr Irina Voss examined the body and noted the time of impact. Her exam report on Solis's submission was due the following morning.
expressions.suspect:felix_morel: Felix Morel had visited the archive six times in the preceding month. He claimed he was researching early recordings of the Kovar sonata.
expressions.suspect:anna_czerny: Anna Czerny delivered flowers to the recital hall before the evening performance. She left through the loading dock and was not seen again until morning.
expressions.suspect:director_pask: Director Pask held the master keycard for all conservatory rooms. He stated he was in his office from eight until the alarm was raised.
expressions.suspect:jan_kovar: Jan Kovar taught composition on the second floor for thirty years. His manuscript notebooks are stored in the archive under restricted access.
expressions.location:royal_conservatory: The Royal Conservatory occupies a stone building on a cobbled square. The main door locks at ten and the stairwell is unlit after nine.
expressions.location:main_stairwell: The main stairwell rises four floors around a central void. The railing on the third-floor landing shows fresh tool marks at two bolt points.
expressions.location:practice_room_six: Practice room six is Solis's assigned space on the second floor. The soundproofing muffles all noise from the corridor.
expressions.location:recital_hall: The recital hall seats two hundred and faces east. The programme for the evening listed Solis performing the prize sonata.
expressions.location:archive_room: The archive room is in the basement behind a coded door. The humidity control runs constantly and the shelves hold manuscripts dating to 1860.
expressions.location:faculty_office: The faculty office shares a wall with the stairwell. A window overlooks the landing and was found open by two inches.
expressions.location:loading_dock: The loading dock opens onto the alley behind the conservatory. The security camera was offline for maintenance that evening.
expressions.location:corridor_landing: The third-floor corridor meets the stairwell at an unlit landing. The overhead lamp was removed for replacement three days prior.
expressions.object:manuscript_score: The original Kovar sonata manuscript sits in the archive under call number K-1987-04. The handwriting does not match the submission copy.
expressions.object:exam_report: The external exam report compares Solis's submitted score with known Kovar works. Two passages are marked as identical.
expressions.object:broken_railing: The stairwell railing broke at two bolt points on the third-floor landing. The bolt threads show fresh file marks.
expressions.object:programme_notes: The evening programme credits Solis as composer of the prize sonata. A footnote thanks Director Pask for his support.
expressions.object:rosin_smear: A smear of violin rosin was found on the stair rail near the break point. The rosin grade matches the brand Solis uses.
expressions.object:key_card_log: The keycard system records all entries to restricted areas. The archive was accessed at 21:47 from a card assigned to the faculty office.
expressions.object:recording_disc: A recording disc from 1989 contains a performance of the Kovar sonata. The performer is listed as a student who left the conservatory that year.
expressions.object:scarf_fragment: A torn silk scarf was found snagged on the stair rail. The fabric matches one worn by Karl Brennan at the recital.
expressions.object:stair_polish: The stairs between the second and third floors carry a fresh coat of polish. The cleaning schedule shows no polish was ordered.
expressions.object:visitors_book: The archive visitors book shows six entries by Felix Morel in the past month. His stated purpose each time was research.
expressions.object:comparison_folio: A side-by-side comparison of the Kovar manuscript and Solis's submission reveals identical phrasing in movements two and three.
expressions.object:ink_analysis: Ink analysis of the submitted score shows two distinct inks. The annotations in the margins are older than the main text.
expressions.object:practice_log: The practice room log shows Solis booked room six from seven to nine. The entry after hers is blank.
expressions.emotion:brittle_poise: She answered every question about the sonata without hesitation. Her bow hand rested on the case but her knuckles were white.
expressions.emotion:sudden_pallor: He lost colour when shown the torn scarf. He said he had not been above the second floor that evening.
expressions.emotion:evasive_phrasing: Each answer about the archive visit was technically accurate and offered nothing more. She spoke as if reading from notes.
expressions.emotion:practised_calm: The director folded his hands on the desk and did not unfold them. His responses were complete and unrevealing.
expressions.emotion:visible_tremor: Kovar's hand shook when the manuscript was placed in front of him. He identified the handwriting as his own without being asked.
expressions.emotion:forced_warmth: Morel smiled at every question and offered to help with the investigation. His eyes moved to the archive door twice.
expressions.modifier:railing_loosened: Two bolts on the third-floor railing were filed down to half their original diameter. The filing was done with a fine-grade metal file.
expressions.modifier:polish_applied: Polish was applied to the stairs between the second and third floors. The application pattern is uneven and concentrated near the landing.
expressions.modifier:scarf_snagged: The scarf fragment caught on a bolt head protruding from the loosened railing. The tear is consistent with a downward pull.
expressions.modifier:ink_mismatch: The submitted score uses two inks that differ in iron content. The marginal annotations match ink manufactured before 1990.
expressions.modifier:corridor_dark: The third-floor corridor has no working lamp. The replacement bulb was ordered but not yet installed.
expressions.modifier:door_ajar: Practice room six was found unlocked and ajar at midnight. The soundproofing seal was not engaged.
expressions.modifier:rosin_on_rail: Violin rosin was found on the railing surface near the loosened bolts. The residue is consistent with transfer from a player's fingers.
expressions.modifier:page_missing: Page seven of the exam report is missing from the faculty office copy. The staple holes show it was removed after binding.
expressions.modifier:handwriting_copied: The submitted score imitates Kovar's notation style but the slant differs by four degrees. A trained graphologist would detect the copy.
expressions.modifier:fresh_polish: The stair polish had not fully dried when the body was found. Application was estimated at less than two hours before the fall.
expressions.action:score_submitted: Solis submitted the prize sonata under her own name four months before the recital. The submission form lists no co-author or source.
expressions.action:stair_polished: Polish was applied to the stairwell steps between the second and third floors. No cleaning staff member claims responsibility.
expressions.action:archive_visited: The archive was accessed at 21:47 during the recital interval. The keycard used was assigned to the faculty office pool.
expressions.action:railing_tampered: Two railing bolts were filed to reduce their load-bearing capacity. The filing was precise and required a specific tool.
expressions.action:exam_confronted: Professor Lang confronted Solis about the manuscript during the interval. A witness heard raised voices near the landing.
expressions.action:recording_erased: The 1989 recording disc was found with its index entry scratched out. The catalogue card in the archive was also removed.
expressions.action:bouquet_delivered: Anna Czerny delivered a bouquet to the recital hall at half past six. She spoke with the stage manager and left via the dock.
expressions.action:folio_compared: Lang placed the Kovar manuscript beside the submitted score on his desk. He marked two passages and circled the date on the original.
expressions.action:door_locked: Practice room six was locked from the corridor side after the recital. The key was found in the faculty office drawer.
expressions.time:recital_interval: The recital interval began at 21:30 and lasted fifteen minutes. The stairwell was accessible from the corridor during this period.
expressions.time:evening_rehearsal: The evening rehearsal ran from seven to nine in the recital hall. Solis performed the prize sonata as the final piece.
expressions.time:body_found_dawn: The cleaning woman found Professor Lang at the bottom of the stairwell at six. The body had been there for several hours.
expressions.time:archive_access: The archive keycard log shows a single entry at 21:47. No exit was logged, suggesting the door was held open.
expressions.time:submission_deadline: The prize submission closed four months before the recital. Solis was the only entrant who submitted a full sonata.
expressions.motive:prize_ambition: The composition prize carries a stipend and a guaranteed recording contract. Solis had applied twice before without success.
expressions.motive:faculty_rivalry: Jan Kovar and Marta Solis competed for the same teaching position. The appointment was pending the outcome of the prize.
expressions.motive:plagiarism_exposure: If Lang's exam report reached the committee, Solis would face expulsion. Her previous degree would also be reviewed.
expressions.motive:funding_loss: Director Pask had secured funding for the conservatory based on the prize winner's reputation. A plagiarism finding would end the grant.
expressions.motive:personal_vendetta: Felix Morel had been romantically involved with Solis the previous year. The relationship ended when she submitted the sonata.
expressions.witness:stage_manager: The stage manager heard raised voices near the third-floor landing at 21:35. He did not investigate because of the interval crowd.
expressions.witness:piano_tuner: The piano tuner was in the recital hall until ten. He saw no one enter from the stairwell side after the interval.
expressions.witness:cleaning_woman: The cleaning woman found the body at six in the morning. She noted the stairs were unusually slippery and the railing was broken.
expressions.witness:front_desk: The front desk logged all keycard swipes after nine. Only three cards were used between 21:00 and 22:00.
expressions.witness:page_turner: The page turner sat beside Solis during the rehearsal. She said Solis played from memory and never opened the score.
expressions.event:professor_lang_discovered: Professor Lang was found at the base of the main stairwell at dawn. His briefcase was open and the exam report was beside him.
expressions.event:evening_recital: The evening recital featured four performers and an interval at 21:30. Solis played the prize sonata to a full house.
